_about: Public-domain William Connor Magee (1821-1891), Bishop of Peterborough and Archbishop of York, preacher, for the Word Hoard: Sermons at St Saviour's, Bath (1852), The Gospel and the Age (1884), Christ the Light of all Scripture (1892) and Growth in Grace (1892), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 47 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
